proof_decision.trust_question: Can a shared user-local guidance transaction recover after any write boundary from a different repository without deleting unknown locks or accepting divergent state?
proof_decision.narrowest_evidence: Two-repository promotion and transition fixtures at the store, owner-registry, and receipt boundaries, plus unknown-lock and concurrent-divergence negatives.
proof_decision.prune_or_replacement_condition: Replace only when the guidance lifecycle contract generates equivalent cross-process, cross-repository recovery and negative lock-admission conformance cases.
proof_decision.residual_risk: Full #2220 promotion, routing, conflict, hygiene, and evidence-boundary closure remains broader than this recovery slice.
